preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acc_product_mapping pm JOIN m_product_loan p ON p.id = pm.product_id JOIN acc_gl_account g ON g.id = pm.gl_account_id WHERE p.external_id = 'LOC_INVOICE_DISCOUNTING' AND pm.financial_account_type = 12 AND g.gl_code = '300017'

changeSet.sql: UPDATE acc_product_mapping pm SET gl_account_id = (SELECT id FROM acc_gl_account WHERE gl_code = '300014') FROM m_product_loan p, acc_gl_account old_gl WHERE pm.product_id = p.id AND p.external_id = 'LOC_INVOICE_DISCOUNTING' AND pm.financial_account_type = 12 AND pm.gl_account_id = old_gl.id AND old_gl.gl_code = '300017';
